newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai interbank rate, baht ease late.
newsitem.headline: Thai interbank rate, baht ease late.

text.p: The Thai interbank overnight rate eased to 8.50-8.75 percent in late trade on Wednesday from 9.25-9.50 percent earlier as banks tried to dispose of excess liquidity, dealers said.
"The rate in the afternoon hovered around 8.50 percent. There are lots of offers but only a few bids," a dealer from Bangkok Bank said.
Dealers attributed the high liquidity in the market to money coming in from selling of stocks on Thailand's weak bourse and government budget disbursements.
"We got a deal at 8.75 percent. I guess money from foreign investors' sales of Thai stocks is still in the system," another dealer from Citibank said.
Amid high liquidity, the baht softened against dollar to 25.437-25.440 from 25.430-25.434 earlier.
But some dollar selling against baht curbed the dollar's rise, dealers said.
One-month swap premiums fell further to 8.00/9.00 satangs from 9.00/10.00 satangs in the morning.
The baht/dollar mid-rate was fixed by the Bank of Thailand at 25.44 against 25.43 on Tuesday.
